description: Create the first part of the standalone HTML file with the document structure, all CSS styles, JavaScript functionality (accordion toggle, copy-to-clipboard), header section with author info, and the first 7 blog articles (Day 1 and Day 2 morning). Articles cover Manulife insurance topics mixing products, business opportunity, and company credibility.
steps: Add inline CSS for: modern blog styling, accordion components (collapsible panels), copy buttons, CTA buttons, responsive design, schedule badges (Pagi/Siang/Sore), hashtag styling
Add inline JavaScript for: accordion toggle functionality (click to expand/collapse), click-to-copy using Clipboard API with visual feedback, smooth animations

Add header section with: blog title 'Satu Yang Terpenting', author bio (Petrus Jakub, Partner Bisnis Manulife, IG @petrusjakub), CTA to https://projectcuan.petrusjakub.workers.dev/ and WA 087781896087
Write Article 1 (Hari 1, 07:00 Pagi) - topic: emotional story about why health insurance matters, strong clickbait title, long-form storytelling style, SEO hashtags
Write Article 2 (Hari 1, 12:00 Siang) - topic: Manulife business opportunity/recruiting, why become an agent, income potential story
Write Article 3 (Hari 1, 19:00 Sore) - topic: unit-link investment insurance product explanation through personal story
Write Article 4 (Hari 2, 07:00 Pagi) - topic: real-life claim story showing importance of life insurance
Write Article 5 (Hari 2, 12:00 Siang) - topic: Manulife company credibility, history, awards, financial strength
Write Article 6 (Hari 2, 19:00 Sore) - topic: education insurance planning for children's future
Write Article 7 (Hari 3, 07:00 Pagi) - topic: retirement planning with Manulife products

Each article must have: clickbait title, schedule badge, accordion wrapper, long-form content (400+ words), emotional storytelling, CTA button to projectcuan link or WA, copy button, SEO tags/hashtags at bottom
acceptance_criteria: File has valid HTML5 structure with DOCTYPE, head with meta tags, and body
All CSS is inline in a <style> tag - no external stylesheets
All JS is inline in a <script> tag - no external scripts
Header shows author info: Petrus Jakub, partner bisnis Manulife, IG @petrusjakub
CTA links point to https://projectcuan.petrusjakub.workers.dev/ and WA 087781896087
7 articles are present with accordion UI (click to expand/collapse)
Each article has a copy button that copies article text
Each article has schedule information (day + time)
Articles use emotional, human-like storytelling - not robotic AI writing
Articles have strong clickbait titles/hooks in first sentences
verification: Run: grep -c 'class="accordion' /projects/sandbox/M-App/satuyangterpenting.wordpress.com.html to confirm accordion elements (expect 7+)
Run: grep -c 'copyToClipboard' /projects/sandbox/M-App/satuyangterpenting.wordpress.com.html to confirm copy functionality
Run: grep 'projectcuan.petrusjakub.workers.dev' /projects/sandbox/M-App/satuyangterpenting.wordpress.com.html to confirm CTA link
Run: grep '087781896087' /projects/sandbox/M-App/satuyangterpenting.wordpress.com.html to confirm WA number
